_comment: Boot to AUX via the settings database (supervisor.Last_Source). This approach does not work: the seed database in system.bin is not the live one, and the USER_DATA payload that carries up_common.sqlite landed in an uppercase SQLITE directory the application never opens (2026-09-14; see docs/VERIFICATION.md). Boot to AUX is done with application patches instead: builds/aux-boot.json. The value is 7: C_MGR_SRC's own scheduler-position enum puts AUX at 7 (0x0169a2e4), the HMI source numbering (the value each C_HMI_AUDIO_APP_BASE OnEventSelect* handler passes to CreateNotificationCommand: FM=1 AM=2 DAB=3 BT=5 CDC=6 AUX=7 iPod=10 Juke=11) agrees, and 4 is not a valid source. Kept as a record of the payload mechanism; user_data ships only up_common.sqlite, which the car owns. `out` ends in a literal SMEG_PLUS_UPG because the updater reads the payload from the hard-coded /bd0/SMEG_PLUS_UPG/NAV/USER_DATA.
